product.name: Spirotech SpiroCombi MB3 Magnetic Air and Dirt Separator
product.description: This SpiroCombi MB3 Magnetic Air Dirt Separator provides a solution for untreated systems where air may cause issues such as flow interruptions or even a complete system breakdown. Specially designed for the simultaneous removal of air and dirt, this SpiroCombi separator removes air, microbubbles and dirt particles from system water continuously. Separating the dirt that mainly consists of magnetite that accumulates wherever a magnetic field is present, this SpiroCombi separator is suitable for valves, heat exchangers, pipes, radiators, pumps and calorimeters. Reducing the costs associated with repairs, parts and downtime, this SpiroCombi separator minimises contamination which if untreated, leads to reduced system performance and therefore higher energy costs without any shut-off valves or bypass required. Features & Benefits: Spirotech SpiroCombi MB3 Magnetic Air and Dirt SeparatorRemoves circulating air and micro bubbles effectivelyVery small particles from 0.005mm are separated and removedDirt can be discharge while the system is in operationNo shut-off valves or bypass requiredConstant low-pressure dropExceptional guarantee

product.name: Spirotech SpiroVent Brass RV2 Air Separator
product.description:
The SpiroVent RV2 by Spirotech is a high performance fully universal deaerator which removes circulating air and microbubbles from system water easily and effectively. Made of brass, it's available in a 22mm or 28mm connection diameter size and operational at pressures of up to 10 bar and temperatures of up to 110°C. The SpiroVent RV2 is ideally positioned at the hottest point of the installation, where the water leaves the heater or enters the cooler.All in all, this energy-saving, easy-to-install air separator greatly reduces the need for manual venting and removes trapped air when installed at the correct location.Features & Benefits: Spirotech SpiroVent Brass RV2 Air Separator Energy-saving brass air separatorEffectively removes circulating air and micro bubblesInhibits the formation of corrosion productsStops irritating noisesRemoves air inclusions and prevents cold radiators
Eliminates the need for manual venting

product.name: Spirotech SpiroCombi PN16 Steel Flanged Air and Dirt Seperator
product.description: This SpiroCombi Airt Dirt Separator is PN16 Steel Flanged and provides a solution for untreated systems where air may cause issues such as flow interruptions or even a complete system breakdown. Separating the dirt that mainly consists of magnetite that accumulates wherever a magnetic field is present, this SpiroCombi separator is suitable for valves, heat exchangers, pipes, radiators, pumps and calorimeters. Reducing the costs associated with repairs, parts and downtime, this SpiroCombi separator minimises contamination which if untreated, leads to reduced system performance and therefore higher energy costs without any shut-off valves or bypass required. product.name: Scalemaster Electrolytic Gold Limescale Inhibitor
product.description:
The Scalemaster Electrolytic Gold Limescale Inhibitor is a cost-effective and maintenance-free solution for reducing limescale build-up in domestic water systems. Designed for easy installation directly onto copper or plastic pipework, this passive device works by altering the structure of scale-forming minerals in the water, making them less likely to adhere to pipes, heating elements, and appliances. It provides effective protection for combi boilers, water heaters, showers, and other hot water systems, extending their lifespan and maintaining efficiency.
Constructed with high-quality materials, the Electrolytic Gold model offers enhanced durability and consistent performance without the need for power supply or ongoing maintenance. Its compact design makes it suitable for installation in tight spaces.. Ideal for homeowners seeking a reliable way to manage hard water issues without chemicals or salt.

product.name: Altecnic Reflex Horizontal Expansion Vessels for Potable Water
product.description: This Reflex horizontal expansion vessel is for potable water. Closed hot water circuits cannot compress water, so any rise in volume from temperature changes needs to be accommodated by an expansion vessel. When water is cold, the pre-charge pressure makes the bladder collapse until the pump starts up as the bladder inflates. The system temperature increases due to the associated increase in pressure and volume, in turn allowing expanded water to enter the bladder adding volume and lowering pressure. With the decrease in temperature decreases, the pre-charge pressure pushes water back to the main water circuit.Features & Benefits: Altecnic Reflex Horizontal Expansion Vessels for Potable WaterFor potable waterAccommodates volume changeSize options available

product.name: Altecnic Reflex Expansion Vessel For Heating System - 8l up to 800l
product.description: The Reflex nitrogen-filled heating expansion vessel range by Altecnic is suitable for use with most heating or cooling systems. The vessels are manufactured to strict PED 97/23/EC Directive and BS EN 13831:2007 'Closed expansion vessels with built in diaphragm for installation in water' standards and tested according to the Pressure Systems Directive. They're available in a wide range of sizes, from 8 litres to more than 800 litres, making them a versatile, convenient solution. The vessels are made by welding the sections together, resulting in a sturdy, reliable structure suitable for internal pressures up to 3 bar for smaller sizes and 6 bar for larger sizes as well as flow temperatures of up to 120°C. They feature a non-replaceable diaphragm and grey-coated epoxy.But that's not all! Reflex vessels have low glass permeability and are resistant to ethylene or propylene glycol mixtures. In addition, there are many benefits to using nitrogen in the vessels. To begin with, nitrogen improves the vessel life span by reducing corrosion inside the vessel and prevents loss of pre-charge pressure. It also permeates through rubber slower than oxygen and is far less reactive to both steel and aluminium, creating fewer debris inside the vessel. Last but not least, nitrogen does not degrade rubber, prolonging the membrane life.Features & Benefits: Altecnic Reflex Expansion Vessel For Heating System - 8l up to 800lDurable nitrogen-filled heating expansion vessels  Consist of a carbon steel shell with carbon steel connections and synthetic rubber diaphragm  Powder Epoxy coating  1.5 bar factory pre-charge  Available in 8l to 800l+ sizes  Maximum vessel temp of 70°CPlease note: 800l+ capacity available, please call for more info.

product.name: Altecnic Pressure Reducing Valve
product.description: The Series 535 range of high performance dial-up pressure reducing valves from Altecnic is designed for hot and cold systems in semi-commercial and industrial applications. They’re pre-adjustable, so you can set them at a required discharge pressure between 1 and 6 bar before installation with the help of the adjustment knob with pressure setting indicator. For greater convenience, the internal cartridge and control knob mechanism come assembled as one unit, making it easy to remove for inspection, cleaning and maintenance. Thanks to the compensated seat design of these pressure reducing valves, the set downstream pressure is independent of upstream pressure variations. In addition, the hydraulic profile makes it entirely possible to achieve low pressure losses even when a large number of outlets are open. The control stem housing of the cartridge consists of a highly adhesion-resistant plastic material, which helps prevent the formation of scale deposits forming. Available in multiple sizes, these valves operate at a maximum inlet pressure of 25 bar at a maximum temperature of 40C°. Features & Benefits: Altecnic Pressure Reducing ValveHigh performance DZR brass pressure reducing valves  Suitable for semi-commercial and industrial applications  Easy to install, clean and maintain  Outlet adjustment range of 1 - 6 bar  Maximum inlet pressure of 25 bar  WRAS approved

product.description: This Reflex vertical expansion vessel is for potable water and comes in various sizing options. For cold water, the pre-charge pressure causes the bladder to collapse until the pump begins as the bladder inflates. product.name: Pegler Yorkshire Xpress Copper Press Fit 45 Degree Male/Female Elbow
product.description: Designed to help you fit your pipes together at a 45° angle, this Xpress copper 45° press street elbow is perfect for you! This product is ideal for domestic maintenance and refurbishment, as well as new build and large-scale public-sector projects. product.name: Pegler Yorkshire Xpress Copper S1S Press Slip Coupling
product.description: This Xpress copper press slip coupling is perfect for connecting copper pipes together. It uses a press tool method that doesn’t need any additional solders, adhesives, or hot works to install and utilises a slip feature that lets the fitting slide over the pipe. This means that your experience will be quick, safe, and easy without long preparation times. Not only does the clean internal bore mean less cleaning, but the copper structures also have no carbon deposits, internal solder, or flux residue – this lessens the risk of corrosion while simultaneously increasing longevity and durability. Xpress products are ideal for domestic maintenance and refurbishment, as well as new build and large-scale public-sector projects, and the systems don’t need to be ‘dry’ for effective jointing. This product is available in varied sizes from 15mm to 108mm.Features & Benefits: Pegler Yorkshire Xpress Copper S1S Press Slip CouplingNo localised annealing due to high-temperature work  Electrical continuity when jointed  Large variety of approvals including Kitemark, WRAS, and DVGW.

product.name: PS605 Bronze Thermal Circulation Valve
product.description: The PS605 Bronze Thermal Circulation Valve is a reliable and innovative solution for maintaining safe and efficient hot water circulation systems. Designed to automatically balance thermal flow and facilitate high-temperature disinfection, this valve ensures optimal system hygiene and safety. Pre-set to approximately 57°C, it effectively prevents bacterial growth within the 22-43°C range. With an automatic disinfection feature activated at water temperatures above 65°C, it provides an added layer of protection against harmful bacteria.Crafted from durable bronze and fitted with EPDM seals, the PS605 is built for long-lasting performance under a pressure rating of PN16. It features a convenient temperature selection dial, as well as isolation and drain functions for easy maintenance and operation. product.name: John Guest Speedfit Superseal Push-Fit Plastic Pipe Insert
product.description: Speedfit plastic pipe inserts by John Guest provide extra support to pipework when connecting a pipe to a fitting. Ideal for hot and cold water and central heating systems, they help keep pipe ends round, minimising any loss of shape which might occur when you’re cutting them. Thanks to the two additional O-ring seals, these inserts support pipework structure and facilitate a more effective seal between the outside diameter of the pipe and the O-ring. Available in sizes from 10mm to 28mm in diameter, Superseal inserts can be used with copper pipes designed to a BS EN 1057 standard and Speedfit barrier pipes designed to a BS7291 standard. product.name: John Guest Speedfit x Union Nut with Service Valve (2 Pack)
product.description: This White PVC Flexi Hose is suitable for the connection of plastic or copper pipe onto a male thread appliance such as a tap and has been designed, manufactured and assembled in the UK by John Guest Speedfit. The PVC material significantly reduces the possibilities of the hose ‘kinking’ and ensures an easier clean. One end of this hose features a push-fit connection for a supply pipe and on the other end, there is a brass nut which can be tightened onto a tap or male thread.  If the need arises to demount the connection, push the collet towards the body of the fitting and pull the pipe to release. This flexi hose fitting ensures an easier working environment in confined spaces and removes the need for hot works on site. Installation can be reduced by around 40% against traditional fixing methods. Maintaining control over the whole process from initial tool design and tool making through to final assembly and testing ensures that this flexi hose is produced to the highest quality. John Guest Speedfit believe that it is this commitment to quality that has led to it receiving awards from many of the world’s leading testing and approvals organisations. Please note: With all plastic pipes, the relevant manufacturer’s insert is required.This flexi hose is not suitable for central heating systems.

product.description: This push-fit flexi hose is suitable for the connection of plastic and copper pipe to a male thread appliance, ideal for connecting taps. It has been designed, manufactured and assembled in the UK by John Guest Speedfit. To isolate your appliance, simply turn the screw in the valve a ¼ turn. To make a connection, simply push the fitting fully onto the pipe and screw the nut onto the thread of the appliance. If the need arises to demount the connection, push the collet towards the body of the fitting and pull the pipe to release. This flexi hose, with a service valve and metal connections, ensures an easier working environment in confined spaces and removes the need for hot works on site. product.name: John Guest Speedfit Push-Fit Stop End
product.description: Speedfit stop ends by John Guest are suitable for capping off pipework at termination points in hot and cold water and central heating system temporarily or permanently. Thanks to the push-fit technology, they’re quick and easy to fit – simply push them fully onto the pipe, and you’re done! product.name: John Guest Speedfit Flexi Hose Nut With Service Valve
product.description: This push-fit flexi hose is suitable for the connection of plastic and copper pipe to a male thread appliance, ideal for connecting taps. It has been designed, manufactured and assembled in the UK by John Guest Speedfit. To isolate your appliance, simply turn the screw in the valve a ¼ turn. To make a connection, simply push the fitting fully onto the pipe and screw the nut onto the thread of the appliance. If the need arises to demount the connection, push the collet towards the body of the fitting and pull the pipe to release. This flexi hose fitting ensures an easier working environment in confined places and removes the need for hot works on site. Installation can be reduced by around 40% against traditional fixing methods. John Guest Speedfit limited offer a two-year guarantee against any defect in materials or manufacture. product.name: John Guest Speedfit Underfloor Heating Manifolds With Push-Fit Connections
product.description: Made of stainless steel, John Guest Speedfit manifolds are quick and easy to install, thanks to the push-fit connections to the heating pipe. To make things even easier, they're pre-fitted with brackets, vibration isolation mounts and an automatic air vent. These manifolds come with protective dust caps on the return rail, which you can remove when installing the product. They also feature circuit actuator valves that open and close the flow of water to each pipe loop. You can assemble them to suit left or right hand supply for greater convenience.And that's not all. These high performance manifolds are approved by the BSI (British Standards Institution), WRAS (Water Regulations Approval Scheme) and several other institutions, so you know they're designed to the highest standards. They're available with anywhere from 2 to 12 ports, making them extremely versatile.Features & Benefits: John Guest Speedfit Underfloor Heating Manifolds With Push-Fit ConnectionsPre-fitted with bracketsIntegral Auto Air Vent discharges any air that might impact circulationValves on the return manifold fully compatible with thermoelectric heads

product.name: John Guest Speedfit Polybutylene Layflat Pipe
product.description: Made in the UK by JG Speedfit, this Layflat Polybutylene Pipe has even greater flexibility, making it incredibly easy to handle and worry-free. This barrier pipe is ideal for long runs where a softer pipe material is an advantage, so cabling through joints becomes a simple task.When removed from the coil, this pipe keeps straight and ‘lays flat’ meaning there are no issues with retaining its memory and trying to coil back into place. It is made of five layers, the centre of which is a coloured oxygen barrier, which prevents air ingress into the system, reducing the effect of corrosion on metal components. Due to its low thermal conductivity when carrying hot water, it is cooler and therefore safer to touch. Features & Benefits: John Guest Speedfit Polybutylene Layflat PipeLays flat and stays flatEasy to handle and ideal for cabling through joists Suitable for central heating systems Polybutylene material for extra flexibility Manufactured and Kitemarked to British Standard BS7291: Parts 2 and Class S Lightweight and ultra flexible Lead-free and non-toxicThe strictest control is maintained because design and manufacture are carried out in modern purpose-built manufacturing centres in west London and Maidenhead in Berkshire. Controlling the whole process, from initial tool design and tool making to final assembly and testing, ensures that only products of the highest quality are produced. John Guest Speedfit believe that this commitment to quality has led to it receiving awards from many of the world’s leading testing and approvals organisations.

product.description:
This hand-tighten-only flexi hose is suitable for the connection of plastic or copper pipe onto a male thread appliance such as a tap and has been designed, manufactured and assembled in the UK by John Guest Speedfit. The flexi hose with an “SV” also features a service valve to isolate the water supply.On one end, this hose features a push-fit connection for a supply pipe and on the other end, there is a plastic nut which can be hand tightened onto a tap or male thread. If the need arises to demount the pipe, simply push the collet towards the body of the fitting and pull the pipe to release. John Guest Speedfit believe that it is this commitment to quality that has led to it receiving awards from many of the world’s leading testing and approvals organisations. Please note: With all plastic pipes, the relevant manufacturer’s insert is required.

product.name: Grundfos UPS2 Light Commercial Pump
product.description:
Grundfos high efficiency UPS2 circulator pumps feature advanced control modes which allow for the adjustment of their performance to the specific system requirements in one- and two-pipe heating systems. These sturdy, versatile pumps are made of cast iron and are suitable for commercial heating as well as domestic hot water recirculation. Their motor is designed with the use of permanent-magnet and compact-rotor ECM (Electronically Commutated Motor, which is highly efficient) technology, which facilitates low energy consumption as well as silent operation and is compliant with the ErP directive No 641/2009. They offer both fixed speed and proportional pressure settings. Grundfos UPS2 pumps have a maximum operating pressure of up 10 bar and can deal with a flow rate of 5.7 m3/h. Models 25-80 (with a 1 1/2" connection) and 32-80 (with a 2" connection) are available. They're compact, with a port-to-port length of 180mm, which makes them an excellent replacement for older models that's easy to install in tight places.Features & Benefits: Grundfos UPS2 Light Commercial PumpHigh performance cast iron circulator pumpsEEI Product SpecificationGrundfos

product.description:
With the addition of this MAGNA1 variable speed circulator from Grundfos, you can deliver the required high energy efficiency, but with a reduced set of features. This pump can offer the perfect solution in a refurbishment situation where you need to either replace a Grundfos UPS product or one of the smaller models from the original Magna family. This pump is designed for circulating liquids in heating systems with variable flows where it is desirable to optimise the settings of the pump duty point, thus reducing energy costs. This MAGNA1 circulator comes complete with electronically controlled motors that are based on permanent magnet (PM) and stator technology. This circulator has been designed for circulating liquids in a wide range of light commercial and commercial applications including heating, air conditioning and cooling, domestic water, ground-source heat pump and solar heating systems. Insulating shells are supplied with single-head pumps for heating systems. This circulator has a wide temperature range where the liquid temperature and the ambient temperature are independent of each other. Product SpecificationMaterial
